description: Bring old expense files into Pace with one ready-to-import ZIP.

defaultPrompt: Bring my old expenses into Pace.
interface.longDescription:
Bring your old expenses into Pace. Add a transaction-only export from a spreadsheet, bank or budgeting app. Pace for ChatGPT checks your spending records and prepares one ZIP to import into Pace.

See your expense total and monthly average without entering everything again. It prepares past expenses only; it does not connect to your bank or move money. If a file cannot be read, it helps you find a usable export.

Files are processed in ChatGPT, separately from the Pace iPhone app.

Get Pace: https://deljojoseph.com/pace

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not accept payments or sell products. The separate Pace iPhone app offers optional purchases through Apple.

publication.release_notes: Updates the published privacy policy with explicit publisher responsibilities, Pace’s retention of plugin expense data, support-data controls and a machine-readable support contact.

name: pace-expense-migration
